summary_en: Interim dividend raised to 120 yen per share from 110 yen forecast, and full-year dividend raised to 240 yen from 220 yen forecast. Total interim payout 8,503 million yen, effective December 1, 2026. Modification based on revised earnings forecast and target consolidated payout ratio of 40%.
title_en: Notice Regarding Modification of Dividend on Surplus (Interim Dividend) and Revision of Year-End Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
Kraftia Corporation raised its interim dividend to 120 yen per share, up from the previously forecast 110 yen per share. The interim dividend payment totaled 8.503 billion yen and became effective on December 1, 2026. For the full fiscal year ending March 31, 2027, the company revised its year-end dividend forecast to 240 yen per share, up from the previously forecast 220 yen per share, resulting in a total annual dividend of 240 yen per share.

The board of directors approved the modifications on October 29, 2026, based on revisions to earnings forecasts announced in the earnings summary. The company stated that it operates under a basic policy of executing progressive dividends—maintaining or increasing payouts—while targeting a consolidated payout ratio of 40% and comprehensively considering business environment, business results, and financial conditions. The interim dividend rose 10 yen from the prior-year interim distribution of 90 yen; the full-year distribution rose 20 yen from the prior year's total of 220 yen.
